dataset.name: RhlA combinatorial protein fitness landscape
dataset.selection_reason: Untouched in NABU repository history; public clean combinatorial dataset with genotype, mutation count, and fitness fields.

candidate_scope.reason: Stay inside the mutation-count regime already validated by frozen V8.3 while allowing higher-order memory when support exists.

budgets.selection: For each p, take the first ceil(p/100 * total_eligible_rows) rows from the deterministic training-pool ordering.

fixed_candidate_pool.definition: Intersection of hidden candidates scoreable by the 5% B3/V8.3 model; the same pool is used at 5%, 10%, 20%, and 40%.

architecture.name: NABU V8.3 Dual-Objective Router
architecture.global_gate: if visible OOF B4 Spearman > B3 OOF Spearman, use global B5
architecture.elite_gate: otherwise allow rank-preserving B5 rerank inside frozen B3 top-20% only if visible OOF elite Top-50 mean percentile improves and Top-1%-hit count does not decrease

primary_metrics_per_budget: Top-50 count of true hidden Top-1% variants

practical_threshold_vs_40pct_reference.definition: smallest budget satisfying all criteria below against the frozen 40% V8.3 reference

router_safety_check.per_budget: V8.3 must be compared against the same-budget B3 baseline on every primary metric.
router_safety_check.purpose: measure whether adaptive routing adds value or protects the pairwise backbone as data availability changes.

anti_leakage.stage_0: package training-pool labels, hidden identities, and sealed hidden truth without printing hidden fitness values
anti_leakage.stage_A: construct all four nested budgets, fit frozen V8.3, choose router mode independently from each budget visible OOF, freeze all predictions/candidates/hashes, then exit
anti_leakage.stage_B: verify every Stage-A hash before loading sealed hidden truth once and evaluating every frozen budget
